summary.value: Hotel Edison is a historic, art deco hotel in the Theatre District, steps from Times Square, at 228 West 47th Street. It suits travelers whose plan is Broadway shows and Midtown sightseeing, with restaurants on site and subway lines close by. Tripadvisor scores it 3.9 Good (18,818), so expect a busy, classic big-city hotel rather than a quiet boutique.
